description: Give any photo a warm vintage look with a real sepia tone matrix.

faqs.a: A classic sepia matrix (for example red = 0.393R + 0.769G + 0.189B), applied pixel by pixel for an authentic vintage tint.
faqs.q: How is the sepia effect computed?

faqs.a: Yes — the image keeps its original resolution; only the tones change.

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Image Sepia Filter
